facts.note: At the nine o'clock bell the husband had everyone show watches; Félix's watch read twenty minutes to nine and the husband scolded him. The transcript calls the husband 'my husband' rather than naming him Aurèle, but it is the same person.
When the temple struck ten she looked at the salon clock, which showed five minutes to ten.
She and the doctor played piquet in the salon without a break until he went out for cigars at twenty-eight minutes past ten by the salon clock.
He asked her to play as he left; she sat at the piano at once, played until he returned, and stopped when he came in.
A moment after he came back, the hall clock struck eleven.
